name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta province, Argentina. The Diablillos deposit hosts a measured and indicated resource of 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold (454 Moz AgEq), making it one of the largest undeveloped silver-gold projects in the Americas. The company is also advancing the La Coipita copper-gold-molybdenum project in San Juan province, Argentina, under an earn-in and joint venture agreement with Teck.
